{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
negative_ninety_nine_nine_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Count of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {negative_ninety_nine_nine_count}')

# Check sample_seq to confirm re-testing
max_sample_seq_by_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
retested_patients = max_sample_seq_by_patient.max() > 1
print(f'Retested patients (max sample_seq > 1): {retested_patients}')"}
